decision.reference: Authorization bead bu-6jcbrx for implementation bead bu-q7vx1q.78 (the Home weekly energy digest judges the house total and each device against week-bucket personal baselines instead of a fixed 20% threshold, calls the week within normal range only on a ready within-band house total, and no longer writes energy_baseline). Reviewed before: simulated base 9a6b5b26c (main 7cbcbfa13faa1fbe593d6a0fbb57555adeeed888 plus bu-t53498, bu-jv1moa.18, bu-q7vx1q.80 and bu-q7vx1q.94.2) as recorded in bu-q7vx1q.78 (contract-review-lane pre-manifest v2; C1 and C2 resolved, C3 fixed with the exact simulated bytes; the formal review bead opens with the DRAFT PR while GitHub access is suspended); approved subject: agent/bu-q7vx1q.78 head 2a5e2e33a plus the reviewer-computed request. Governing requirement REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 (Energy Digest Job) in openspec/specs/home-deterministic-jobs/spec.md, whose ID-only header lands in this same change ahead of the manifest. The 17 owners in tests/jobs/test_home_energy_digest.py are retained: 12 lose only import context; the other 5 pinned the retired prose energy_baseline loader and 20% threshold and now pin the band rule, with test_detect_anomalies keeping its base parametrization. The branch also carries one content-addressed temporary archived-landed freeze (scripts/archived-requirements-baseline.json), bound here as an input and removed by bu-xpdfom when add-personal-baselines archives. This exact manifest requires its own independent review and protected-main publication before consumption; provenance text grants no runtime admission.

Graded a device against a parsed prose energy_baseline fact with the 20% anomaly_pct and 100% high_severity_pct thresholds through detect_anomalies, which no longer exists. REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 (Anomaly detection) now flags a device above its own ready week band and grades it high at twice the band's centre. The test keeps its name and intent over anomalies_from: a week inside the usual range gives no anomaly, one above it gives anomaly, and one at more than double gives high.

Asserted that detect_anomalies returns nothing with no prose baseline and skips a zero prose baseline. REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 (Thin history is not an anomaly) now leaves a device with no ready week band unflagged. The test keeps its name and both edges over anomalies_from: no history or fewer than four weeks gives no anomaly, and a band with a zero centre is skipped.

Pinned the prose-baseline contract: it patched _load_energy_baselines and _load_energy_thresholds and expected five store_fact calls (the overall and per-device energy_baseline facts plus two spikes). REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 now judges each device against its week-bucket band and forbids energy_baseline writes. The test patches the history fetch and the scorer, still expects two anomalies and the 320 kWh total, and now asserts exactly the two energy_spike writes and baseline_updated from a changed band.

Asserted that _load_energy_baselines was not awaited and patched the threshold loader. REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 (Partial cumulative-energy statistics) now forbids scoring a partial run at all, so the test asserts the scorer is not awaited and keeps every other partial-run assertion, including no overall fact.

Asserted that _load_energy_baselines was not awaited; that loader no longer exists. REQ-home-deterministic-jobs-006 (No cumulative-energy statistics available) still forbids computing or storing a baseline, so the test asserts the scorer is not awaited and keeps its no-store_fact, notification and error-result assertions.
